name: Generate meals, navigate Cook With Me backward, and start over
description: Verifies a new user can clear the short onboarding and complete the primary ListoMeal flow with local recipe matching, guided cooking, and a clean reset.
steps: If the first-run welcome is shown, review the three steps and click Start cooking
Confirm the homepage shows the family hero, benefit highlights, and prominent Scan Your Fridge or Pantry card, then type chicken, rice, broccoli, onion
Choose 20 minutes and select Air Fryer from the appliance cooking-method cards, then click Give me 3 meals
Open Cook With Me on the first meal, advance to the next step, then use Back
Close Cook With Me and click Start New Recipe below the meal cards
expected: Three recipe cards are shown, Cook With Me can move forward and back to the prior step, and Start New Recipe clears the old results and returns to fresh ingredient entry.

name: Save family preferences and use them later
description: Verifies a family can store preferences without needing an account.
steps: Set adults to 2, kids to 2, allergies/avoid to peanuts, and dislikes to mushrooms
Save the profile and refresh the page, then return to Family Profile
expected: The saved family counts and peanut/mushroom preferences remain visible after refresh.

name: Favorite, rate, and send tester feedback
description: Verifies a generated meal can be kept, rated, and followed by durable tester feedback submission.
steps: Generate meals from eggs, potatoes, cheese, and tortillas
Open Cook With Me on the first meal, finish it, and choose Loved it
Open the Feedback button, choose thumbs up, select an optional reason, type a short comment, and send it
expected: A thank-you confirmation appears after feedback is stored, and the rated recipe remains in History and Favorites.

name: Deep Scan common foods and package labels locally
covers: common fridge and pantry food recognition
description: Verifies Deep Scan combines local vision models with package-label reading to recognize more common foods without using the AI backend.
steps: Open Scan It and confirm the help text describes Deep Scan, on-device label reading, and no AI-credit use
Choose a bright close photo containing a supported visible food or a clearly readable package label such as milk, eggs, cheese, chicken, tortillas, rice, beans, or pasta
Review the detected ingredients in Pick It
expected: A supported visible food or readable package label is converted into an editable ingredient selection without calling the AI backend.

name: Recipe photo lookup failure keeps meal cards usable
description: Verifies that a photo-service failure never prevents users from reading or cooking a generated recipe.
steps: Type pasta, tomatoes, cheese and onion
Open Cook With Me on a meal card even though its photo lookup failed
expected: The recipe card shows the branded photo fallback and Cook With Me still opens normally.
